name: mix-ladder
description: Open-model TOTAL-rate ladder for mixed entries: stepped flow rate at FIXED ratios (5 -> 10 -> 20 -> 40 per second, 1m ramp + 3m plateau each) — locates the knee of the mixed shape, contention included. Stages are literals: RATE=/DURATION= do not apply; to change the shape edit this file or copy a variant.
_verdict: Same doctrine as ladder.json: a measurement round, not a judgment round — apiSla:false, no strict verdict line; the lenient breaker protects the shared environment while still capturing post-knee data. Read each plateau from Grafana (manifest epochMillis brackets the windows); if 429s appear, the curve is valid only up to the last clean step.
_pools: Pool demand = the pool-owning flow's INTEGRAL over all stages x 1.2 (plannedIterations integrates trapezoids, preflight enforces and prints the exact demand when short). trade-mix-full example (ratios .1/.2/.05 -> per-flow targets 1/1/2/4, 1/2/4/8, 1/1/1/2): integrals ~1800/3360/1140 -> pools >= 2160/4032/1368 (seed ITERATIONS ~2800/5300/1800 allows harvest loss). trade-mix-book/-amend split at their own ratios — trust the preflight numbers. Each iteration is ONE HTTP request, so top-step HTTP RPS ~= the summed rounded per-flow targets (~40 req/s).

thresholds._circuitBreaker: Breaker only: wholesale business rejection aborts after delayAbortEval; no verdict line — the knee is the deliverable, not PASS/FAIL.
